name: Tenkiame
source:
In the middle of summer vacation, the protagonist receives news that his grandfather has fallen ill. Taking the place of his busy parents, he traveled a bit reluctantly to his grandparents’ home. Luckily, his grandfather’s situation wasn’t serious, and he spent time with his grandmother, who he hadn’t seen in a long time. She mentioned that the greenery in the area will soon disappear as it is razed for urban development. He lamented that it was a sign of the times.

As he sat on the porch, feeling the cool breeze and listening to the soothing sound of the swaying wind chimes, he thought it was a very comfortable feeling. He noticed a small girl next to him, basking in the gentle sunlight. He was captivated by her beautiful hair, ears and smile. This is the beginning of a small love story with an innocent and curious white fox and a quiet and meddlesome fox.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/08/01/august-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
暑假中期，主人公接到了爷爷生病的消息。他代替忙碌的父母，有些不情愿地来到了祖父母家。幸运的是，爷爷的情况并不严重，他也和许久未见的奶奶在一起。她提到，由于城市发展，该地区的绿化很快就会消失。他感叹这是时代的标志。

他坐在门廊上，感受着凉爽的微风，听着风铃摇曳的舒缓声音，他觉得这种感觉很舒服。他注意到旁边有一个小女孩，沐浴在柔和的阳光下。他被她美丽的头发、耳朵和微笑迷住了。这是一个天真好奇的白狐和一只安静爱管闲事的狐狸之间的小爱情故事的开始。

[来自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/08/01/august-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
